name: Bored Activity Discovery
description: A compact, refreshable random activity suggestion with its practical constraints and an optional activity link.
template:
<Stack gap="xs">
  <Group justify="space-between" wrap="nowrap">
    <Text fw={600} truncate>Bored activity</Text>
    <RefreshButton requestId="random" label="Another idea" />
  </Group>
  {status.random?.loading ? <Skeleton height={130} /> : status.random?.ok === false ? <Alert color="red" title="Activity unavailable">{status.random.statusText || status.random.error || "Request failed"}</Alert> : !data.random?.activity ? <Text size="sm" c="dimmed">No activity was returned</Text> : <Stack gap="xs">
    <Text fz={24} fw={700} lh={1.15}>{data.random.activity}</Text>
    <SimpleGrid minColWidth={140} autoFlow="auto-fit" spacing="xs">
      <Stack gap={2}><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Type</Text><Text size="sm" fw={600} truncate>{({ education: "Education", recreational: "Recreational", social: "Social", diy: "DIY", charity: "Charity", cooking: "Cooking", relaxation: "Relaxation", music: "Music", busywork: "Busywork" })[data.random.type] ?? data.random.type ?? "Unknown"}</Text></Stack>
      <Stack gap={2}><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Participants</Text><Text size="sm" fw={600}>{data.random.participants == null ? "Unknown" : data.random.participants.toLocaleString("en-US") + (data.random.participants === 1 ? " person" : " people")}</Text></Stack>
      <Stack gap={2}><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Price score</Text><Text size="sm" fw={600}>{data.random.price == null ? "—" : Math.round(data.random.price * 100) + "%"}</Text></Stack>
      <Stack gap={2}><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Availability</Text><Text size="sm" fw={600}>{data.random.availability == null ? "—" : Math.round(data.random.availability * 100) + "%"}</Text></Stack>
      <Stack gap={2}><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Accessibility</Text><Text size="sm" fw={600} truncate>{data.random.accessibility ?? "Unknown"}</Text></Stack>
      <Stack gap={2}><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Duration</Text><Text size="sm" fw={600}>{({ minutes: "Minutes", hours: "Hours" })[data.random.duration] ?? data.random.duration ?? "Unknown"}</Text></Stack>
      <Stack gap={2}><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Kid-friendly</Text><Text size="sm" fw={600}>{({ true: "Yes", false: "No" })[data.random.kidFriendly] ?? "Unknown"}</Text></Stack>
    </SimpleGrid>
    {data.random.link ? <Anchor href={data.random.link} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">Open activity</Anchor> : null}
  </Stack>}
</Stack>
